paite: Gamdai leh phaksap gam akipak ding a; gamkeu in nuamsa in pawn pak bang in apak ding.
heading: Sianthouna Lamlian
english: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

paite: Apaklun ding a, kipaktak leh la sa in nuam asa ding hi. Lebanon thupina akiang ah piak ahi ding, Karmel leh Sharon kilawmna toh; TOUPA thupina amu ding ua, i Pathian kilawmna toh.
english: It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory Lebanon will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see Yahweh’s glory, the excellence of our God.

paite: Khut hatloute hatsak unla, khukzawte kipsak un.
english: Strengthen the weak hands, and make firm the feeble knees.

paite: Lungtang dawilokte kiang ah, "Hattak in om unla, lau kei un! Ngai un, na Pathian uh phulakna toh, a Pathian thukna toh, ahong pai ding a, hon hondam ding," chi un.
english: Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong. Don’t be afraid. Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.

paite: Huai hun chiang in mittawte mit hahsak in a-om ding a, nangongte bil hihvak in a-om ding.
english: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.

paite: Huai hun chiang in khebaite sakhi bang in atawm ding ua, pau theiloute lei in nuamsatak in la asa ding uh; gamdaite ah tuite ahong phulkhe ding ua, gamkeute ah luita tui ahong phulkhe biabia ding uhi.
english: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.

paite: Huchi in piaunel sa mahmah munte dil ahong suak ding a, lei dangtak mahmah tui nak ahong suak ding; sehalte tenna a, alupna uah, loupa, maute leh sikhapat toh a-om ding.
english: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.

paite: Huan huai ah lamlian a-om ding a, kongpi toh, huai Sianthouna Lampi achi ding uh; mithanghuai in lampi atawn kei ding, himahleh huai mite a ding in ahi zaw ding; mi vialzinte, ahi, mihaite leng, huai ah amang kei ding uhi.
english: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called The Holy Way. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools will not go there.

paite: Humpinelkai himhim huai ah a-om kei ding a, sa hing ne himhim huai ah apaitou sam kei ding uh, muh phak in leng a-om kei ding ua, himahleh tatsate bel huai ah apaitou ding uh.
english: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.

paite: TOUPA tatsate akik nawn ding ua, lasa kawm in Zion atung ding uh, tangtawn a kipahna alutung uah a-omta ding a; nopsakna leh kipahna angah ding ua, lungkhamna leh thumna amang ding hi.
english: The Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”
